newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Main trading on Tel Aviv Stock Exchange cancelled.
newsitem.headline: Main trading on Tel Aviv Stock Exchange cancelled.

text.p: The Tel Aviv Stock Exchange on Tuesday decided not to hold the main session of trading in the 100 most liquid stocks after a strike by Bezeq Israel Telecom workers created communications problems.
A bourse spokeswoman said brokerage houses and banks could not get through to the exchange.

The morning session of call market trading known as the Meretz took place as usual. The Meretz session determines the market trend and executes small orders while the bulk of trading in the 100 most liquid stocks takes place in the later session known as the Mishtanim.
The strike over government plans to privatise more of Bezeq has curtailed telephone repair and operator information services.
A labour court on Tuesday morning ordered Bezeq workers to end their week-long strike.
Bezeq union chief Shlomo Kfir said workers' representatives would meet soon to decide whether to abide by the court's decision.
